cells.gaps: The latest figure, 53 per cent given as current in the 2025 NDP6 implementation plan, is below 80 per cent; the plan as reported gives no survey year.
cells.note: The government's NDP6 implementation plan gives 53 per cent as current internet use, a government figure that replaces the International Telecommunication Union's estimate of 64.9 for 2024. It is above 50 and below 80 per cent.
